description: Plays up to six MPX parts through one FluidSynth and one SoundFont: each part on its own sound from the bank, with a channel for each of its strings so that bends and legato stay on the string they belong to, mixed to stereo.

params.name: Level
params.text: How loud the whole band is, from 0 to 4 times: at 1, a note sounds as loud as the same note from mpxGuitar.

params.name: Humanise
params.text: How much the timing, loudness and lengths of the notes are varied, from 0%, where the same notes come out the same way every time, through 100%, the amount the rules file sets, to 200%.

params.name: Reverb
params.text: FluidSynth's own reverb, on or off.

params.name: Chorus
params.text: FluidSynth's own chorus, on or off.
Silences one part without unpatching it.

inputs.text: One part: its notes and how each is played, from Guitar Chart or any MPX source, on the sound chosen for it.

notes: The bank is the first SoundFont in DreamerMPX/banks; another is chosen from the right-click menu. A part's sound is chosen by clicking its name, from the bank's own list.
Drums are a part like any other: a kit from the bank, playing General MIDI drum numbers.
